Job Description:

Leader Amélioration des Données / Data Improvement Lead

English job description follows***

Description de l'emploi :

Vous avez une expérience confirmée dans l'analyse de données et la gestion de la performance, vous avez travaillé sur l'amélioration de processus et la digitalisation, et vous souhaitez évoluer tout en développant de nouvelles compétences ? Ce poste est pour vous !

Le programme d'avions commerciaux A220 recherche un Leader en amélioration des données pour rejoindre notre équipe Performance Management basée à Mirabel (Québec, Canada), où vous collaborez étroitement avec les analystes de performance, les équipes des Opérations et l'équipe de digitalisation.

Vous ferez partie de l’équipe Performance Management chargée de développer la standardisation et l'amélioration de la qualité des données de performance pour la chaîne de valeur A220, tout en soutenant la feuille de route de digitalisation. L'organisation de l'équipe est établie de manière à promouvoir la collaboration transversale et l'autonomie, dans un esprit de soutien mutuel et d'apprentissage collectif.

Dans ce rôle, vous agirez en tant que point de contact central et facilitateur entre les analystes de la performance opérationnelle et l'équipe de digitalisation. Votre mission sera d'optimiser l'efficacité des processus d'assemblage de l'A220 en coordonnant l'amélioration des données provenant de divers flux : approvisionnement secondaire, SDO ( Supplier Disruption Over Cost ), coûts récurrents (RC) et CVAT ( Customer Value Added Time ). Vous identifierez les besoins en automatisation, harmoniserez les méthodes d'analyse et assurerez la transition des analyses manuelles vers des solutions digitales robustes pour améliorer la rentabilité globale.

Votre environnement de travail:

Le siège du programme d'avions commerciaux A220 est situé à Mirabel, dans la région métropolitaine de Montréal, à deux pas de la ville dynamique de Montréal. Réputée pour son environnement paisible et sûr, la région offre une grande qualité de vie aux jeunes professionnels ou aux professionnels expérimentés, ainsi qu'aux familles, en équilibrant parfaitement les opportunités de carrière et les activités de plein air, ce qui en fait un endroit vraiment spécial où il fait bon vivre.

Parce que nous prenons soin de vous :

Avantages financiers : Salaire attractif, bonus annuel, régime d’assurances collectives, régime de retraite et régime d’achat d’actions.
Équilibre vie privée / professionnelle : Une politique de travail hybride (selon les besoins opérationnels), une cafétéria sur site, une politique de congés très concurrentielle.
Bien-être / santé : Programme d’Aide aux Employé.e.s (PAE), programme de rabais, service médical sur site, accès à un service de navette publique entre Laval (station de métro Montmorency) et Mirabel, et une application de covoiturage.
Développement individuel : des opportunités d’évolution et des possibilités de formations nombreuses (catalogue de plus de 10.000 e-formations disponibles en libre accès pour développer votre employabilité, certifications, programmes de développement accéléré, mobilité nationale et internationale).

Chez Airbus, nous vous aidons à travailler, à vous connecter et à collaborer plus facilement et de manière plus flexible. Partout où cela est possible, nous favorisons la flexibilité dans nos modes de travail afin de stimuler l'esprit d'innovation.

Vos défis :

Assurer le lien principal entre les analystes (Performance, SDO, RC, CVAT) et l'équipe de digitalisation pour traduire les besoins métiers en solutions automatisées;
Garantir la qualité, la cohérence et l'exactitude des données de performance issues des flux d'approvisionnement et de production;
Harmoniser la définition et le suivi des indicateurs clés de performance (KPI) à travers les différents flux pour assurer une vision transverse de la performance;
Identifier les opportunités d'automatisation des rapports de performance (hebdomadaires, mensuels, trimestriels) et superviser leur mise en œuvre par l'équipe technique;
Consolider les points de blocage majeurs identifiés par les analystes du pôle Performance Management afin de prioriser la feuille de route de digitalisation selon l'impact sur la performance des opérations;
Préparer et présenter des feuilles de route claires et des visualisations de données aux parties prenantes pour soutenir la planification stratégique;
Collaborer avec les départements Opérations, Finances et Qualité pour optimiser la performance globale de la chaîne de valeur.

Votre profil:

Vous détenez un baccalauréat en ingénierie;
Vous détenez un minimum de 10 ans d’expérience dans un système industriel;
Vous possédez une expérience pertinente en analyse de données, en gestion de la performance ou en amélioration de processus;
Vous maîtrisez les outils d'analyse et de visualisation de données tels que Power BI, Skywise et Python;
Vous avez une connaissance approfondie des entrepôts de données, de l'analytique en nuage et de l'automatisation des processus;
Vous possédez de solides compétences en résolution de problèmes et une capacité démontrée à collaborer avec des équipes interfonctionnelles;
Vous avez la capacité de vulgariser des concepts de données complexes pour les rendre accessibles aux équipes opérationnelles et de direction;
Vous avez une expérience confirmée dans la définition de cadres de mesure de performance et la création de structures d'analyse complexes.

Ce poste peut impliquer des déplacements professionnels.

Déplacements requis :

Ce travail nécessite une prise de conscience liée à tous les risques potentiels de conformité et à un engagement à agir avec intégrité, ces valeurs sont le fondement du succès, de la réputation et de la croissance durable de l'entreprise.

Job description :

You have proven experience in data analysis and performance management? Have you worked on process improvement and digitalization, and are you looking to grow and develop new skills? This role is for you!

The A220 Commercial Aircraft Program is seeking a Data Improvement Leader to join our Performance Management team based in Mirabel (Quebec, Canada), where you will collaborate closely with performance analysts, Operations teams, and the digitalization team.

You will be part of the Performance Management team responsible for developing standardization and improving performance data quality for the A220 value chain, supporting the digitalization roadmap. The team is structured to promote cross-functional collaboration and autonomy, fostering mutual support and collective learning.

In this role, you will act as a central point of contact and facilitator between operational performance analysts and the digitalization team. Your mission will be to optimize the efficiency of the A220 assembly processes by coordinating data improvement across various streams: secondary supply, SDO (Supplier Disruption Over Cost), Recurring Costs (RC), and CVAT (Customer Value Added Time). You will identify automation needs, harmonize analytical methods, and ensure the transition from manual analysis to robust digital solutions to improve overall profitability.

Your working environment:

The A220 commercial aircraft Programme is headquartered in Mirabel, in the greater Montreal area, where the vibrant city of Montreal is just a stone’s throw away. Known for its peaceful and safe environment, the region offers a high quality of life for younger or experienced professionals and families, perfectly balancing career opportunities and outdoor activities that makes it a truly special place to call home.

How we care for you:

Financial rewards: Attractive salary, annual bonus, group insurance plan, pension plan and share purchase plan.
Work / Life Balance: A hybrid working policy (based on operational needs), on-site cafeterias and a highly competitive holiday policy.
Wellbeing/Health: Employee Assistance Program (EAP), Discount Program, on-site Medical Service, access to a public shuttle service between Laval (Montmorency metro station) and Mirabel, and a carpooling application.
Individual development: Great upskilling opportunities and development prospects with unlimited access to +10.000 e-learning courses to develop your employability, certifications, accelerated development programmes, national and international mobility.

Your challenges:

Act as the primary liaison between analysts (Performance, SDO, RC, CVAT) and the digitalization team to translate business needs into automated solutions;
Ensure the quality, consistency, and accuracy of performance data collected from supply and production flows;
Harmonize the definition and monitoring of Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) across various flows to guarantee a cross-functional view of performance;
Identify automation opportunities for performance reporting (weekly, monthly, quarterly) and oversee their implementation by the technical team;
Consolidate major roadblocks identified by the Performance Management analysts to prioritize the digitalization roadmap based on its impact on Operational Performance;
Strategic Communication: Prepare and present clear roadmaps and data visualizations to stakeholders to support strategic planning;
Collaborate with Operations, Finance, and Quality teams to optimize the overall value chain performance.

Your boarding pass:

You hold a Bachelor’s degree in Engineering;
You have a minimum of 10 years of experience in an industrial system;
You possess relevant experience in data analysis, performance management, or process improvement ;
You are proficient in data analysis and visualization tools such as Power BI, Skywise, and Python;
You have in-depth knowledge of data warehousing, cloud analytics, and process automation;
You possess strong problem-solving skills and a demonstrated ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams;
You have the ability to simplify complex data concepts for operational and executive leadership teams;
You have proven experience in defining performance measurement frameworks and creating complex analytical structures.

Business Travel May Be Required For This Position.

Travel requirements: < 5% (Occasional trips to the United States)

jobs.description:
Axial Search is a specialist executive search firm built for one kind of hire: leaders who help organizations navigate AI transformation. Apply today to express your interest in roles like this one.

Visit our website to learn more about our process and explore free tools for your job search, including our live job market dashboard with salary, skills and hiring trend data from thousands of AI transformation roles.

What The Market Looks Like

We've tracked 38 executive-level AI strategy postings across Canada in the last six months, with strongest hiring concentration in Toronto, Montreal, and Vancouver. Organizations across technology, financial services, professional services, and healthcare are competing for fractional Chief AI Officer talent, typically engaging advisors 15–25 hours per week at hourly rates between $250–$400 depending on scope and track record. The strongest candidates bring 10+ years of enterprise leadership experience, a track record of shipping AI/ML initiatives end-to-end, and the ability to translate between board-level strategy and engineering execution—combining business acumen with genuine technical fluency.

Lead AI strategy development and roadmap definition, translating organizational goals into phased, measurable AI/ML initiatives that drive competitive advantage
Partner with executive leadership (CEO, CFO, CTO) to assess AI readiness, identify highest-ROI use cases, and build the business case for investment
Own governance, risk, and ethical AI frameworks—ensuring compliance, data governance, and responsible AI practices across the organization
Build and mentor the AI/ML capability within the organization, whether through hiring, vendor partnerships, or upskilling existing teams
Oversee vendor evaluation and selection for AI tools, platforms, and services; manage key technology partnerships
Monitor emerging AI trends and competitive landscape; advise on organizational positioning and capability gaps
Drive post-implementation value realization, tracking KPIs and ROI across deployed AI/ML projects

Candidate Requirements

10+ years of executive or senior leadership experience driving AI, data science, or digital transformation initiatives in enterprise settings
Demonstrated success shipping 3+ end-to-end AI/ML projects from conception through deployment and value realization
Strong technical fluency in machine learning, generative AI, and AI architecture—comfortable reviewing model performance, data pipelines, and infrastructure decisions
Proven ability to communicate AI strategy to both technical teams and non-technical stakeholders (boards, C-suite, business units)
Experience building or scaling AI/ML teams, assessing talent gaps, and partnering with vendors or consultancies
Track record in data governance, AI ethics, and risk management in regulated or high-stakes environments

jobs.title: Director, Technology Delivery
jobs.description:
Permanent Full Time

We are looking for a Director, Technology Delivery – Finance & Actuarial
to lead technology delivery across our Finance and Actuarial portfolio.

This is a leadership role spanning technology strategy, portfolio delivery, modernisation, operations and people. The Director will partner with business and technology leaders to shape multi-year technology roadmaps, deliver complex change and ensure the portfolio remains secure, resilient and positioned to support evolving business priorities.

The successful candidate will bring strong technology leadership, strategic thinking and delivery experience, with the ability to connect business priorities, technology direction and execution. They will operate effectively at both the strategic and delivery levels, build strong teams and partnerships, and bring clarity and accountability to a complex portfolio.

What you will do:

Lead technology delivery across the Finance and Actuarial portfolio, ensuring investment and delivery align with business priorities and strategic outcomes.
Partner with Finance and Actuarial leaders to translate business strategy into multi-year technology roadmaps, investment priorities and executable plans.
Help shape and execute the technology strategy for the portfolio, aligned with enterprise architecture and broader technology priorities.
Provide technology leadership across complex initiatives, from strategy, architecture and solution design through implementation, transition and ongoing operations.
Lead cross-functional teams spanning architecture, engineering, data, integration, security, operations and programme delivery.
Provide clear leadership across scope, funding, sequencing, dependencies, technology risk and delivery trade-offs.
Drive portfolio modernisation, reducing legacy complexity and technical debt while improving resilience, scalability and maintainability.
Ensure technology solutions are secure, sustainable and aligned with enterprise architecture, engineering, security and regulatory standards.
Build strong relationships across business and technology teams to manage dependencies and deliver integrated outcomes.
Lead strategic vendor and technology partner relationships, ensuring clear accountability for outcomes, quality, value and delivery commitments.
Drive portfolio planning and prioritisation, balancing transformation investment with modernisation, technical health, regulatory requirements and operational priorities.
Use portfolio, delivery and operational metrics to understand performance, identify opportunities and drive continuous improvement.
Build and develop high-performing teams, growing technical capability, developing future leaders and creating a culture of accountability, collaboration and continuous improvement.
Provide senior leaders with clear visibility into portfolio health, investment requirements, key decisions, risks and outcomes.

What you will bring:

Post-secondary education in computer science, engineering, business or a related discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
Significant progressive experience in technology leadership and delivery, including leading and developing high-performing teams.
Demonstrated experience developing and executing technology strategies and multi-year roadmaps.
Strong delivery leadership, with the ability to translate business priorities into technology outcomes and drive complex initiatives through to delivery.
Experience leading complex initiatives across applications, data, integration, security and technology infrastructure.
Strong business, technical and architectural judgement, with the ability to balance strategic direction with pragmatic delivery decisions.
Demonstrated ability to build trusted relationships, influence across organisational boundaries and solve complex business problems through technology.
Experience with portfolio planning, investment prioritisation, financial management and vendor management.
Ability to navigate ambiguity, challenge existing approaches and make pragmatic decisions that balance business outcomes, risk, cost, quality and speed.
Strong communication and influencing skills, with the ability to make complex technology topics understandable to both technical and non-technical audiences.
A bias for action, curiosity and critical thinking, with the ability to adapt as business and technology priorities evolve.
A growth mindset and commitment to continuous learning and improvement.

What will set you apart:

Experience leading large-scale enterprise transformation programmes involving significant business, process and technology change.
Experience leading technology within Finance and/or Actuarial environments, or other complex financial-services functions.
Experience with ERP transformation or modernisation, with SAP S/4HANA experience considered a strong asset.
Experience working across global business segments and technology teams, navigating different priorities and operating models to deliver enterprise-wide outcomes.
Experience leading geographically distributed teams and working with global delivery models.
A track record of turning technology strategy and roadmaps into measurable business outcomes.

The base salary for this position is between $130,000 - $155,000
annually. This represents base salary only and does not represent other variable compensation components of our total compensation ( i.e. annual bonus, commission etc). If you are selected to move forward in our recruitment process, your recruiter will be able to discuss additional details of our total rewards program with you.

jobs.title: Director, Data Engineering (Permanent/full-time)
jobs.description:
CoreFactor is searching for a Director, Data Engineering on a permanent/full-time basis for a client in the GTA.

This position is hybrid and will require the successful incumbent to go into the office two (2) days per week.

This role provides technology leadership across core digital assets including Secure Web, Public Web, & Secure Mobile, and related enablement platforms such as client identity and access management, and an internal design system.

The role combines strategic leadership, technical oversight, people leadership, delivery execution, operational accountability, and vendor/financial management to drive technology excellence and measurable business value. Embed test-and-learn, automation, and continuous improvement practices to improve speed, quality, and sustainability.

Lead, mentor, and develop technology leaders and teams, fostering a collaborative, inclusive, accountable, and execution-focused culture.
Design and optimize team structures to support clear ownership, delivery outcomes, modernization priorities, and clear accountabilities.
Partner with Chapter, Engineering, Product, and Business leaders on workforce planning, role clarity, succession planning, and capability development.
Build internal capability in digital engineering, enablement, agile delivery, vendor management, and operational excellence.
Coach leaders to manage performance effectively, clarify ownership, and build resilient teams through change and transformation.

Lead budget management, including annual planning, cost tracking, capitalization, forecasting, and investment prioritization.
Manage strategic vendor and system integrator relationships, holding partners accountable for delivery quality, outcomes, knowledge transfer, and value realization.
Drive cost transparency and technology spend optimization across applications, infrastructure, security, vendor, and platform investments.
Identify opportunities to reduce long-term dependency on external partners while strengthening internal platform ownership and capability.

Ensure stability, security, technology currency, resiliency, and end-of-life decommissioning for applications within scope.
Establish governance processes that balance speed of delivery with risk management, audit, regulatory, cybersecurity, and control requirements.
Partner with Application Operations to ensure effective incident management, change management, disaster recovery, and business continuity planning.
Proactively manage operational risk, application health, technical debt, and service reliability across shared digital capabilities.

Act as a strategic technology partner to leaders across Product, Client Experience, Business, Operations, Architecture, Cybersecurity, and Enterprise Technology.
Communicate digital strategy, delivery status, risks, trade-offs, and dependencies with clarity and transparency.
Represent the Digital technology function in executive forums, bringing enterprise perspective, external insight, and pragmatic recommendations.
Strengthen alignment between technology investments, business priorities, Client experience outcomes, and enterprise digital strategy.

Oversee execution across delivery teams, vendors, system integrators, and enterprise partners.
Establish governance, track delivery metrics, and drive productivity, quality, and reliability improvements.
Manage budgets, vendor relationships, and cost optimization opportunities.
Build and sustain a high-performing, engaged, inclusive, and platform-oriented technology organization.
Ensure digital platforms are secure, scalable, resilient, reusable, and positioned to support future growth.

What you need to succeed?

Qualifications & Experience

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field; advanced degree or MBA is an asset.
10+ years of experience in senior technology leadership roles with demonstrated success delivering complex, mission-critical digital platforms.
Experience leading modernization and enablement of digital platforms such as identity, web, mobile, integration, or client/advisor experience platforms.
Proven ability to lead technology teams through transformation, platform ownership, and operating model evolution.
Strong financial acumen with experience managing sizable technology budgets, vendor portfolios, and total cost of ownership.
Strong stakeholder management, executive communication, and organizational leadership skills.
Experience in regulated financial services is valuable; depth in digital enablement, engineering excellence, and vendor-heavy delivery environments is prioritized.

Decisive leader comfortable operating in ambiguity, complexity, and transformation.
Strong technical credibility with the ability to challenge architecture, delivery practices, platform decisions, and CI/CD approaches.
Builder mindset with equal focus on fixing, scaling, enabling, and simplifying.
Pragmatic, outcomes-driven decision-maker who balances speed, stability, risk, and long-term application health.
Collaborative leader who builds trust, drives momentum, and creates clarity across complex stakeholder groups.
Critical thinker who challenges the status quo constructively and drives continuous improvement.
Strong coaching orientation with a commitment to developing leaders, teams, and internal capability.

What’s in it for you?

A competitive salary and bonus program, based on market scale
A flexible group insurance program starting on your first day of work to meet your needs and those of your family.

new_jobs.description:
You are as unique as your background, experience and point of view. Here, you’ll be encouraged, empowered and challenged to be your best self. You'll work with dynamic colleagues - experts in their fields - who are eager to share their knowledge with you. Your leaders will inspire and help you reach your potential and soar to new heights. Every day, you'll have new and exciting opportunities to make life brighter for our Clients - who are at the heart of everything we do.

At Sun Life, we're driven by our Purpose: helping our Clients achieve lifetime financial security and live healthier lives. Our values shape how we work: caring, authentic, bold, inspiring, and impactful.

When you join Sun Life, you'll work with passionate colleagues and empowering leaders who support your growth and celebrate your contributions, so you can make a meaningful difference in our Clients' lives.

Discover how you can make a difference in the lives of individuals, families and communities around the world.

Job Description:

Role Summary

The AVP Technology Lead – Digital is a strategic technology leader responsible for enabling, scaling, and modernizing Sun Life Canada’s shared digital platforms that support secure, connected, and frictionless Client and advisor experiences. This role provides technology leadership across core digital assets including Secure Web, Public Web, & Secure Mobile, and related enablement platforms such as client identity and access management, and an internal design system.

The role combines strategic leadership, technical oversight, people leadership, delivery execution, operational accountability, and vendor/financial management to drive technology excellence and measurable business value. The AVP partners closely with Product, Client Experience, Architecture, Cybersecurity, Operations, Engineering, and Business leaders to ensure digital assets are resilient, scalable, secure, reusable, and aligned to enterprise priorities.

This role operates in a complex, high-visibility environment where digital platform reliability, modernization, and cross-business enablement are critical to Client outcomes. The leader must be able to bring clarity to a broad mandate, make decisions in ambiguity, and build a high-performing technology organization that balances speed, stability, security, and long-term platform health.

What will you do?

Technology Strategy, Platform Enablement & Engineering
Shape, communicate, and align the digital technology strategy across business units, ensuring it supports near-term delivery commitments and longer-term modernization objectives.
Partner with Business Leads, Product, Client Experience, Architecture, Cybersecurity, Operations, and Enterprise Technology to define platform roadmaps, OKRs, sequencing, and investment priorities.
Provide thought leadership on the evolution of shared digital platforms, including identity, web, mobile, integration, data enablement, and reusable digital capabilities.
Promote technology stack standards, modern engineering practices, automation, and architectural discipline, balancing build vs. buy vs. partner decisions in a complex technology ecosystem.
Ensure design and engineering decisions account for reusability, scalability, security, maintainability, accessibility, and technical debt reduction.
Create the conditions for exceptional digital experiences by enabling business and product teams with reliable, scalable, secure, and reusable platforms.
Platform Delivery & Execution
Accountable for end-to-end delivery of digital platform capabilities, including oversight of internal delivery teams, vendors, system integrators, and total cost of ownership.
Drive delivery excellence by improving velocity, quality, reliability, predictability, and agile maturity across multiple squads.
Track delivery metrics, identify bottlenecks, and implement targeted productivity and delivery maturity improvements.
Serve as the primary escalation point for platform, delivery, vendor, and dependency-related issues, enabling rapid resolution in a complex environment.
Ensure delivery is integrated across product, architecture, engineering, operations, cybersecurity, and business priorities.
Embed test-and-learn, automation, and continuous improvement practices to improve speed, quality, and sustainability.
People Leadership & Capability Development
Lead, mentor, and develop technology leaders and teams, fostering a collaborative, inclusive, accountable, and execution-focused culture.
Design and optimize team structures to support clear ownership, delivery outcomes, modernization priorities, and clear accountabilities.
Partner with Chapter, Engineering, Product, and Business leaders on workforce planning, role clarity, succession planning, and capability development.
Build internal capability in digital engineering, enablement, agile delivery, vendor management, and operational excellence.
Coach leaders to manage performance effectively, clarify ownership, and build resilient teams through change and transformation.
Financial & Vendor Management
Lead budget management, including annual planning, cost tracking, capitalization, forecasting, and investment prioritization.
Manage strategic vendor and system integrator relationships, holding partners accountable for delivery quality, outcomes, knowledge transfer, and value realization.
Drive cost transparency and technology spend optimization across applications, infrastructure, security, vendor, and platform investments.
Identify opportunities to reduce long-term dependency on external partners while strengthening internal platform ownership and capability.
Operational Excellence, Risk & Security
Ensure stability, security, technology currency, resiliency, and end-of-life decommissioning for applications within scope.
Establish governance processes that balance speed of delivery with risk management, audit, regulatory, cybersecurity, and control requirements.
Partner with Application Operations to ensure effective incident management, change management, disaster recovery, and business continuity planning.
Proactively manage operational risk, application health, technical debt, and service reliability across shared digital capabilities.
Cross-Functional Collaboration & Stakeholder Engagement
Act as a strategic technology partner to leaders across Product, Client Experience, Business, Operations, Architecture, Cybersecurity, and Enterprise Technology.
Communicate digital strategy, delivery status, risks, trade-offs, and dependencies with clarity and transparency.
Represent the Digital technology function in executive forums, bringing enterprise perspective, external insight, and pragmatic recommendations.
Strengthen alignment between technology investments, business priorities, Client experience outcomes, and enterprise digital strategy.

Accountabilities

Align digital strategy with business objectives, Client outcomes, enterprise standards, and shared technology priorities.
Define and monitor roadmaps, OKRs, modernization priorities, and delivery sequencing.
Oversee execution across delivery teams, vendors, system integrators, and enterprise partners.
Establish governance, track delivery metrics, and drive productivity, quality, and reliability improvements.
Manage budgets, vendor relationships, and cost optimization opportunities.
Build and sustain a high-performing, engaged, inclusive, and platform-oriented technology organization.
Ensure digital platforms are secure, scalable, resilient, reusable, and positioned to support future growth.

What you need to succeed?

Qualifications & Experience

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field; advanced degree or MBA is an asset.
10+ years of experience in senior technology leadership roles with demonstrated success delivering complex, mission-critical digital platforms.
Experience leading modernization and enablement of digital platforms such as identity, web, mobile, integration, or client/advisor experience platforms.
Proven ability to lead technology teams through transformation, platform ownership, and operating model evolution.
Strong financial acumen with experience managing sizable technology budgets, vendor portfolios, and total cost of ownership.
Strong stakeholder management, executive communication, and organizational leadership skills.
Experience in regulated financial services is valuable; depth in digital enablement, engineering excellence, and vendor-heavy delivery environments is prioritized.
As this position is posted in several locations, we specify that bilingualism (French, English, both oral and written) is required for Quebec only for the frequent interactions with English and French-speaking colleagues or internal partners across Canada or worldwide

Mindset & Behaviours

Decisive leader comfortable operating in ambiguity, complexity, and transformation.
Strong technical credibility with the ability to challenge architecture, delivery practices, platform decisions, and CI/CD approaches.
Builder mindset with equal focus on fixing, scaling, enabling, and simplifying.
Pragmatic, outcomes-driven decision-maker who balances speed, stability, risk, and long-term application health.
Collaborative leader who builds trust, drives momentum, and creates clarity across complex stakeholder groups.
Critical thinker who challenges the status quo constructively and drives continuous improvement.
Strong coaching orientation with a commitment to developing leaders, teams, and internal capability.

What’s in it for you?

A competitive salary and bonus program, based on market scale
A flexible group insurance program starting on your first day of work to meet your needs and those of your family.
Time off that allows you to focus on the moments that matter most. 20 vacation days per year.
Our Share Ownership Program gives you the opportunity to invest in Sun Life while benefiting from employer matching contributions.
We are proud to be included in Great Place to Work's 2026 list of Canada's Best Workplaces.
A warm, supportive, and inclusive culture.

Certain sales focused roles have sales incentive plans based on individual or group sales results.

new_jobs.title: Senior Director, Partner Success
new_jobs.description:
1Password is growing.
We’ve surpassed $500M in ARR and we’re continuing to accelerate, earning a spot on the Forbes Cloud 100 for four years in a row and teaming up with iconic partners like Oracle Red Bull Racing.

About 1Password

At 1Password, we’re building the foundation for a safe, productive digital future. Our mission is to unleash employee productivity without compromising security by ensuring every identity is authentic, every application sign-in is secure, and every device is trusted. We innovated the market-leading enterprise password manager and pioneered Unified Access Management, a new cybersecurity category built for the way people and AI agents work today. As one of the most loved brands in cybersecurity, we take a human-centric approach in everything from product strategy to user experience. Over 180,000 businesses, from Fortune 100 leaders to the world’s most innovative AI companies, trust 1Password to help their teams securely adopt the SaaS and AI tools they need to do their best work.

If you're excited about the opportunity to contribute to the digital safety of millions, to work alongside a team of curious, driven individuals, and to solve hard problems in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, then we want to hear from you. Come join us and help shape a safer, simpler digital future.

Reporting to the Chief Business Officer, you will build and lead a scalable Partner Success organization for 1Password. You’ll define how partners onboard, build expertise, deliver customer value, and grow their businesses while shaping lifecycle programs, operating models, and measurable success outcomes. By helping partners deliver secure, reliable experiences for their customers, you’ll extend 1Password’s mission to more organizations.

How We’re Using AI Today

On the Corporate Development team, AI is a force multiplier helping us build trust across the business and bring big partnership ideas to life. We’re using AI to work smarter and align teams faster, from drafting partnership proposals and generating intelligence briefings to creating product mock-ups and demos that support impactful cross-functional work. AI also helps us bring clarity and consistency to our day-to-day operations, giving us more time for strategic thinking, relationship-building, and meaningful collaboration across 1Password.

This is a remote opportunity within Canada and the US.

What We're Looking For

Bring 12+ years of experience in partner success, customer success, channel operations, or related roles in Business-to-Business (B2B) software, including experience leading teams and managing managers. Experience within an AI-forward organization is considered a strong asset.
Demonstrate success building or scaling a partner-facing organization with measurable improvements in partner productivity, customer retention, expansion, and satisfaction.
Understand partner business models, particularly managed service providers and resellers, including recurring revenue, service delivery, and the economics of a profitable partner practice.
Design lifecycle programs, partner segmentation, success plans, health scoring, and executive engagement across a diverse partner portfolio.
Apply strong commercial judgment and analytical skills to connect partner engagement and customer adoption with revenue outcomes and investment decisions.
Build trust with partner leaders, lead complex escalations, and influence priorities across Sales, Customer Success, Product, Marketing, Support, Operations, and Finance.
Translate strategy into repeatable processes, lead through change, and establish clear accountability in a growing organization; experience in cybersecurity, identity and access management, or another technically complex Software as a Service (SaaS) category is a plus.

What You Can Expect

Define the Partner Success strategy, team structure, coverage model, and investment priorities, while hiring, coaching, and developing a high-performing team.
Establish partner journeys covering onboarding, activation, enablement, adoption, renewal, and expansion, with clear milestones, accountability, and escalation paths.
Create differentiated engagement models for technology and strategic partners by combining dedicated support with digital programs and self-service resources.
Develop joint success plans and executive business reviews that connect partner capability, customer adoption, service delivery, and commercial growth.
Partner with enablement and technical teams on training, certification, deployment readiness, and repeatable practices that help partners deliver successful customer outcomes.
Identify partner and customer risk early, coordinate recovery plans and growth opportunities, and clarify ownership across renewals and commercial execution.
Build partner health scoring, dashboards, forecasting inputs, and business reviews while turning partner feedback into improvements across products, programs, processes, and support.

USA-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between $256,000 USD and $384,000 USD, plus immediate participation in 1Password's benefits program (health, dental, 401k and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs.

Canada-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between $240,000 CAD and $360,000 CAD, plus immediate participation in 1Password’s generous benefits program (health, dental, RRSP and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs.

At 1Password, we approach each individual's compensation with a promise of fair market value and internal equity commensurate with experience and specific skill set.

This posting is for an existing vacancy.

Our culture

At 1Password, we prioritize collaboration, clear and transparent communication, receptiveness to feedback, and alignment with our core values: keep it simple, lead with honesty, and put people first.

You’ll be part of a team that challenges the status quo, and is excited to experiment and iterate in search of the best solution. That said, 1Password is not for everyone . Our work is demanding, we strive for excellence, and the pace is fast. We need people who are keen to take on challenging problems, who seek feedback to grow, and who are driven to make an impact. If you're looking for a place where you can settle into a comfortable routine, this might not be the right fit for you. We’re looking for individuals who are proven experts in their fields, as well as those who are highly adaptable, can thrive in ambiguity and through change, are curious, and above all deliver results.

How We Work With AI

We are committed to leveraging cutting-edge technology—including AI—to achieve our mission. We also understand that thinking critically about AI in its current forms will help us create better solutions for our customers and ourselves with its future forms, which will help us continue to close the gap between security and privacy and achieve our mission. We want team members at all levels to take the approach of actively learning AI best practices, identifying opportunities to apply AI in meaningful ways, and driving innovative solutions in their daily work. Embracing the future of AI isn't just encouraged—it's an essential part of how we will be successful at 1Password.

This approach extends to our hiring process—candidates are welcome to use AI tools responsibly and thoughtfully during the application process. To us, this means we do ask that you join live interviews without using AI tools so we can get to know how you communicate, solve problems, and collaborate with others.

Our approach to remote work

We believe in the power of remote work, but recognize that in-person connection is important to help us achieve our mission. While we are a remote-first company, travel for in-person engagement is a part of almost all roles, and we require our employees to be ready and willing to take part. Frequency will depend on role and responsibilities, and may include, but is not limited to: annual department-wide offsites, team meetings, and customer/industry events.

What We Offer

We believe in working hard, and rewarding that hard work through our benefits. While not an exhaustive list, here is a glance at what we currently offer:

Health and wellbeing

👶 Maternity and parental leave top-up programs

🩺 Competitive health benefits

🏝 Generous PTO policy

Growth and future

📈 RSU program for most employees

💸 Retirement matching program

🔑 Free 1Password account

Community

🤝 Paid volunteer days

🏆 Peer-to-peer recognition through Bonusly

🌎 Remote-first work environment

Some roles in our GTM team are currently being hired for in-person hybrid work in Toronto and Austin. These roles will specify on the posting.

You belong here.
